finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-1] Provider ID (clerkId) not indexed
File: prisma/schema.prisma (L8-L16)
Evidence: User model defines clerkId String? with no @@index or @@unique, while server code performs prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { clerkId: userId } }) to resolve Clerk users.  
Impact: Lookup by clerkId will cause full table scans as users grow, turning every admin/auth lookup into expensive DB work and risking DB overload at high traffic.  
Fix: Add an index/unique constraint on clerkId (e.g., @@index([clerkId]) or make it unique if appropriate) and migrate the schema.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-2] Webhook user creation is racy / not idempotent
File: src/app/api/webhooks/clerk/route.ts (L120-L210)
Evidence: handleUserCreated does a findUnique by email then create (if not found) instead of an upsert; concurrent or repeated webhook deliveries can hit the unique email constraint and fail.  
Impact: Duplicate or retried Clerk events can cause webhook 500s, missed user-synces, and noisy DB errors under load.  
Fix: Replace find/create with a single upsert (or transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE) and use clerkId as the upsert key where possible; add idempotency handling for retries.

[AUTH-3] Redundant auth validation on protected admin routes
File: src/middleware.ts (L1-L40) and src/app/api/admin/check-admin/route.ts (L1-L40)
Evidence: middleware uses clerkMiddleware + auth.protect for /api/admin/*, but protected API handlers still call await auth() and then perform additional DB lookups for the same identity.  
Impact: Extra auth() calls and duplicate verification add latency and CPU per request (2x+ auth work), multiplying auth overhead at scale.  
Fix: Let middleware validate auth and pass identity via request context/headers, then avoid re-calling auth() in handlers; cache the resolved user mapping for short TTL if a DB lookup is required.

--- INFO ---

[AUTH-4] Webhook signature verification implemented with Svix
File: src/app/api/webhooks/clerk/route.ts
Evidence: The webhook verifies payloads using Svix.verify with a CLERK_SIGNING_SECRET, providing proper signature validation.
